results.text:
our step-by-step logo design process at http://kargul.studio. 🔖

for us, the logo is the most important part of the brand identity.

we start with research into the business, competitors and visual landscape, then usually present 3 to 5 genuinely different concepts every few days. we get feedback, learn what’s working and keep exploring from there.

sometimes it takes 5 concepts, sometimes 10, sometimes 20+. there’s no fixed cap because the logo is usually the most recognisable and long-lasting asset in the brand.

once the direction is right, we refine the geometry, spacing, proportions and optical balance, test it across sizes, monochrome versions, lockups and different typography pairings.

then we build the full brand around it: colour system, typography, layouts, imagery, applications, templates and the wider design system so everything works consistently across product, web, social and print.
